alternatives.conclusion: In scope, measured at fair value
alternatives.notes: Rejected: criterion (f) is explicit; self-issued tokens held in treasury are not assets of the issuer.

judgments.basis: ASC 350-60-15-1(f) excludes assets created or issued by the reporting entity or its related parties. Token terms section 1 establishes DemoCo as issuer.
judgments.proposedConclusion: No. WDEMO fails criterion (f): it was created by the reporting entity. It is not recognized as an asset of the issuer; the issuance is analysed separately.
judgments.question: Is WDEMO, a token DemoCo created and issued, a crypto asset within ASC 350-60-15-1?
judgments.topic: ASC 350-60 scope of the self-issued WDEMO token
